title: No independent set of five in the cubic-residue graph mod 13
statement: Let $G$ be the graph on the thirteen vertices $\bbz/13\bbz$ in which two distinct vertices are joined by an edge exactly when their difference is a cubic residue modulo $13$, that is, an element of $\{1,5,8,12\}$. Then $G$ contains no independent set of five vertices: among any five vertices, some two are adjacent.
hypotheses_covered: adjacency: distinct vertices whose difference is a cubic residue {1,5,8,12}
conclusion: no independent set of size 5
replaced:
\emph{The cubic-residue graph mod 13
contains no independent set of five vertices.}
